# Lib.numbers.bool.combine

## Operators

- [**All**](All.md) — Returns true if all of the connected booleans are true.
- [**And**](And.md) — Returns True if both inputs are true. Consider using [All] if you want to test more than two booleans for true.
- [**Any**](Any.md) — Returns true if any of its inputs are true.
- [**Or**](Or.md) — Returns true if one of its inputs is true. Consider using [Any] if you want to test more than two booleans.
